title: Leonurine Inhibits Hepatic Lipid Synthesis to Ameliorate NAFLD via the ADRA1a/AMPK/SCD1 Axis.
authors: Fan, Wen; Pan, Maoxing; Zheng, Chuiyang; Shen, Haiyan; Pi, Dajin; Song, Qingliang; Liang, Zheng; Zhen, Jianwei; Pan, Jinyue; Liu, Lianghao; Yang, Qinhe; Zhang, Yupei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究益母草碱通过ADRA1a/AMPK/SCD1轴改善NAFLD的脂质代谢机制，核心为疾病表型与信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Leonurine is a natural product unique to the Lamiaceae plant Leonurus japonicus Houtt., and it has attracted attention due to its anti-oxidative stress, anti-apoptosis, anti-fibrosis, and metabolic regulation properties. Also, it plays an important role in the prevention and treatment of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) through a variety of biological mechanisms, but its mechanism of action remains to be elucidated. Therefore, this study aims to preliminarily explore the mechanisms of action of leonurine in NAFLD. Mice were randomly divided into four groups: the normal control (NC) group, the Model (M) group, the leonurine treatment (LH) group, and the fenofibrate treatment (FB) group. The NAFLD model was induced by a high-fat high-sugar diet (HFHSD) for 12 weeks, and liver pathological changes and biochemical indices were observed after 12 weeks. Transcriptomic analysis results indicated that leonurine intervention reversed the high-fat high-sugar diet-induced changes in lipid metabolism-related genes such as stearoyl-CoA desaturase 1 (Scd1), Spermine Synthase (Sms), AP-1 Transcription Factor Subunit (Fos), Oxysterol Binding Protein Like 5 (Osbpl5), and FK506 binding protein 5 (Fkbp5) in liver tissues. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis results suggest that leonurine may exert its lipid-lowering effects through the AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling pathway. Liver lipidomic analysis showed that leonurine could alter the abundance of lipid molecules related to fatty acyl (FAs) and glycerophospholipids (GPs) such as TxB3, carnitine C12-OH, carnitine C18:1-OH, and LPC (20:3/0:0). Molecular biology experiments and molecular docking techniques verified that leonurine might improve hepatic lipid metabolism through the alpha-1A adrenergic receptor (ADRA1a)/AMPK/SCD1 axis. In summary, the present study explored the mechanism by which leonurine ameliorated NAFLD by inhibiting hepatic lipid synthesis via the ADRA1a/AMPK/SCD1 axis.
abstract_zh: 益母草碱是唇形科植物益母草（Leonurus japonicus Houtt.）特有的天然产物，因其抗氧化应激、抗凋亡、抗纤维化及代谢调节等特性而受到关注。此外，它通过多种生物学机制在非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）的预防和治疗中发挥重要作用，但其作用机制仍有待阐明。因此，本研究旨在初步探讨益母草碱在NAFLD中的作用机制。小鼠被随机分为四组：正常对照组（NC）、模型组（M）、益母草碱治疗组（LH）和菲诺贝特治疗组（FB）。通过高脂高糖饮食（HFHSD）诱导NAFLD模型，持续12周，并在12周后观察肝脏病理变化和生化指标。转录组学分析结果表明，益母草碱干预逆转了高脂高糖饮食诱导的肝脏组织中脂质代谢相关基因的变化，如硬脂酰辅酶A去饱和酶1（Scd1）、精胺合酶（Sms）、AP-1转录因子亚基（Fos）、氧甾醇结合蛋白样5（Osbpl5）和FK506结合蛋白5（Fkbp5）。京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析结果表明，益母草碱可能通过AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）信号通路发挥其降脂作用。肝脏脂质组学分析显示，益母草碱能改变与脂肪酰基（FAs）和甘油磷脂（GPs）相关的脂质分子丰度，如TxB3、肉碱C12-OH、肉碱C18:1-OH和LPC（20:3/0:0）。分子生物学实验和分子对接技术验证了益母草碱可能通过α-1A肾上腺素能受体（ADRA1a）/AMPK/SCD1轴改善肝脏脂质代谢。总之，本研究探讨了益母草碱通过ADRA1a/AMPK/SCD1轴抑制肝脏脂质合成从而改善NAFLD的机制。
